title: Chopin · Étude Op. 10 No. 1 (Waterfall)
explanation: A C-major étude built from continuous right-hand arpeggios over a sustained left-hand harmonic foundation. The Mutopia/Peters score and MIDI preserve the source staves; use Parts & accompaniment to adapt redistributions for your own hand span.
attribution: Mutopia Project 914, Etüde C-Dur, F.F. Chopin Opus 10 No. 1; Peters/Herrmann Scholtz (1900b), typeset by Roland Goretzki. Public domain.
